notes: Cash-basis village. Governmental data from p4 (Statement of Receipts, Disbursements, and Changes in Fund Balances - Governmental Activities, Total Governmental Funds): beginning 17,517 + receipts 196,349 - disbursements 451,002 = ending (237,136); the ending balance is total assets incl. CDs and county treasurer cash (General Fund cash is overdrawn, (686,187)). Business-type (Electric, Water, Sewer, Garbage, Leasing) from proprietary statement p6, roll-forward p7; measure recorded as cash-basis net position (equals cash + CDs + meter deposits). Business-type nonoperating interest income, misc income, interest charges and debt payments are printed below operating totals on p6; reported_totals business-type use the budget schedule's printed totals on p12 (Total receipts 1,011,827; total disbursements 787,958), which equal operating + nonoperating. Business-type statement 'Purchased services' 393,028 is mostly Electric purchased services 322,968 (p12, likely purchased power), so category Purchased Power/Cost of Sales with review (attempt 3). Balance sheet (attempt 3): governmental lines from the governmental funds Statement of Assets and Fund Balances (p3, Total Governmental Funds; fund balance by classification: Reserved for capital improvements 152,124, Assigned 296,927, Unassigned (686,187)), whose total (237,136) equals the government-wide governmental column on p2; business-type lines from p2 Business-Type Activities column; totals from the p2 Total column; no liabilities printed. General Fund detail uses the p11 departmental schedule (General and Administrative = general government, Police = public safety, Park = culture/recreation, Other column mixes functions so category other with review); the p8 General Fund budget schedule duplicates its Total column and is not recorded (no double counting). Only lines with an actual amount are recorded; budget-only lines (e.g., Street capital outlay 40,000, Street debt proceeds budget 1,440,000, budgeted transfers) are omitted. Street Fund detail from p10. Utility fund lines recorded per fund (Electric, Water, Sewer, Garbage, Leasing) from p12; Total Proprietary Funds column not recorded to avoid double counting. The p13 all-fund budget schedule is a summary and not recorded. Repairs and maintenance in General and Administrative column is blank (the 10,504 on that line in the image belongs to Supplies).
